home.heroTitle: Lost Something on Campus? Let's Find It Together.
home.heroSubtitle: khojbeen.ai uses intelligent TF-IDF matching and location-time heuristics to reunite students and faculty with their missing belongings instantly.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search lost or found items by keyword (e.g. blue bottle, student ID)...
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to report, match, and reclaim missing belongings across campus desks.
home.step1Desc: Submit details of lost or found belongings with category, campus spot, and verified live photo.
home.step2Desc: Our TF-IDF and semantic algorithms match text, location zones, and date proximity automatically.
home.step3Desc: Submit proof of ownership online, get approved by campus desk coordinators, and collect your item.
home.recentItemsSubtitle: Live feed of items registered by students and security desks across campuses.
